assumptions: psnr-y = Kind::PsnrY: BT.709 full-range luma 0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B in f64 on the encoded u8 values, squared-error mean, then dB (classical.rs:60-67). Counted as written; Rust does not contract a*b+c into fma.
Luma is computed inline per pixel for both images inside one fold (no Y plane is materialized); the stage models the joint loop with images=1 and 6 u8 loads per pixel-pair.
The fold's intrinsic span is log-depth (method defines a mean); the implementation iterates sequentially.
psnr() tail: mse==0 cmp, then 10*log10(255*255/mse); the sum/n division from luma_mse is counted in to_db.

stages.name: BT.709 luma both images + squared error accumulate
stages.notes: per px: 2x luma (3 cvt + 3 mul + 2 add each), delta (1 add), delta^2 (1 mul), fold add (1 add)
